description:
## Add to Morphe

[Add MiXplorer Sharing Fix](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=ak800i/mixplorer-patches-for-morphe)

## Supported Input

MiXplorer **6.71.15-BETA**, package `com.mixplorer.beta`, **ARM64 build 26090412** only. Use the [official beta APK](https://mixplorer.com/beta/MiXplorer_v6.71.15-BETA_B26090412-arm64.apk).

## Changes and Verification

- External `_data` queries return null; same-UID paths, filenames, sizes, MIME types, and content URI access are preserved.
- Includes the free beta's required local-signing compatibility support.
- Seven bytecode tests pass. The actual patched provider and same-UID behavior were verified on an Android 13 phone; both synthetic file hashes match.
- Live Telegram UI/network uploads have not been tested.

**Back up settings before replacing an official beta.** Android cannot update an official installation with an APK signed by Morphe's different key. Stable/Silver installations are separate and unsupported by this patch.

Only the patch bundle and audited source are distributed. No modified MiXplorer APK, signing keys, private files, or device identifiers are included.
